key_insight: Sensitivity analysis helps anticipate which bubbly-liquid parameters a physics-informed neural network can recover from nonlinear waveforms.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support characterization of bubbly media for ultrasound applications by identifying parameters that measurably influence wave propagation.
method: Model weakly nonlinear propagation with a Korteweg–de Vries–Burgers equation.
Assess eight physical parameters through coefficient- and solution-level sensitivity analyses.
Use a PINN for forward prediction and single-parameter inverse estimation.
evidence_signal: Across seven single-parameter inverse tests, five parameters were estimated within 0.8–2.1% error; the polytropic exponent converged partially, while surface tension could not be estimated.
watch_item: Single-parameter results do not establish reliable joint estimation of multiple parameters, especially those with weak waveform sensitivity.
paper_title: Sensitivity-Guided Parameter Estimation of Bubbly Liquid via a Nonlinear Wave Equation and Physics-InformedNeuralNetworks
